items.title: Saquon Barkley: Not spotted at practice
items.text:
Barkley wasn't present for the media-access portion of Wednesday's practice, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Questionable for Thursday after no practice
items.text:
Tuten (ankle/foot) is listed questionable for Thursday's game against the Ravens.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Shipped to Baltimore
items.text:
The Ravens agreed to acquire Brissett from the Cardinals on Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Hunter Henry: Sitting out first practice of Week 9
items.text:
Henry (foot) wasn't on the field for the media-access portion of Wednesday's practice, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tanner McKee: Benched for Joe Milton in Week 9
items.text:
McKee will shift to a backup role for Sunday's game against the Giants with the Eagles set to move forward with Joe Milton as their starting quarterback in Week 9, Adam Schefter of ESPN and Mike Garafolo of NFL Network report.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
